subject: Renewal + capacity uplift — plan to defend against replacement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Kline <ari@windfall.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Windfall renewal and potential capacity uplift

Hi Ari —

Quick note as we approach your contract renewal window (June 30) — wanted to open a conversation about two things we heard from your team during Q1: 1) a potential 2–3x capacity uplift for peak traffic later this year, and 2) you’re running an impartial performance review with a few vendors.

We believe there are straightforward ways to both secure predictable capacity and keep per-token economics stable as you scale. Monica will be your CS lead on operational and benchmarking logistics. Would you be open to a short call this week to align on the bake-off scope and any performance baselines Windfall needs?

If it helps, we can draft a short technical checklist and reserved-capacity proposal ahead of time.

Thanks —
Marissa
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: windfall_usage_report_Q1.csv

From: Ari Kline <ari@windfall.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Windfall renewal and potential capacity uplift

Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up. We are running a short evaluation, and RivalAI has been vocal about a 15–20% unit-cost improvement with their newer runtime. That said, our top priority is tail latency under burst — we can’t tolerate >300ms p99 on inference for critical paths.

We are interested in a bake-off. If Redwood can demonstrate p99 <= 250ms at our 95th-percentile burst profile and offer some commitment credit on reserved capacity, we’ll keep this on the table. Procurement (cc’d) will need the official commercial terms.

Ari
CTO, Windfall
ari@windfall.io

Cc: Procurement <procurement@windfall.io>

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Windfall renewal and potential capacity uplift — bake-off prep

Team — forwarding Ari’s note. Highlights: competitor benchmarking vs RivalAI, tight p99 target (<=250ms), asks for reserved-capacity credit.

Reqs:
- Ben: commercial save plan + an early incentive we can offer (credits/price collar).
- Monica: technical runbook for a controlled bake-off (workloads, dataset slices, steady state + burst).
- Logan: can you prepare a quick KV-cache + batching baseline for their current model (we have one from Q1 usage report attached)?

We should aim to have a consolidated proposal and the bake-off checklist to Ari by Friday EOD (Apr 6). Short sync Thu 10am?

Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Apr 2028 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Windfall bake-off — commercial save plan draft

Marissa / team —

Draft of what I think will land:
1) Technical POC: 2-week isolated bake-off window, Redwood provides a pre-provisioned cluster matching Windfall’s burst profile.
2) Performance SLA: target p99 <= 240ms for their critical model slices during the controlled test. If we miss by >10% we allow a one-time credit equal to 15% of the month’s reserved fee.
3) Commercial incentive: 20% credit against first 3 months of committed Dedicated capacity (min 6-month commit) if they sign before renewal date.
4) Upsell/guardrail: Offer a pilot for our Vector Search add-on at a 50% introductory price for 90 days — positions us to expand into retrieval workloads and capture more spend.
5) Contingency: If RivalAI shows best-in-class price but we meet performance, offer an incremental discount tied to sustained p99 under 250ms for 60 days post-rollout.

I attached redwood_save_plan_v3.docx with language suitable for procurement. Happy to tighten numbers after sync.

Ben
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

Attachments: redwood_save_plan_v3.docx

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Kline <ari@windfall.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Apr 2028 10:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Bake-off scope and benchmark instructions (attached)

Hi Ari —

Thanks for the quick response and the p99 target. Attached is a short benchmark_instructions_v1.pdf — it outlines:
- Test harness (requests per second profile + burst window),
- Dataset slices (critical vs non-critical routing),
- Measurement points (p50/p95/p99 end-to-end and model-only),
- Environment parity checklist (quantization, batch-size caps, GPU types).

We’ll provision sandbox capacity for a two-week window and will run three controlled bursts at days 3/7/11. Logan will run the KV-cache + batching baseline and share the first run by EOD Thu.

If this looks good, we’ll lock calendar for the test window Apr 16–29 and circulate a final SOW + MSA amendment for the reserved capacity credit.

Monica
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

> Attachment: benchmark_instructions_v1.pdf

From: Ari Kline <ari@windfall.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@windfall.io>
Date: Fri, 06 Apr 2028 14:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bake-off scope and benchmark instructions (attached)

Monica / team —

Thanks for the level of detail. A couple follow-ups before we lock dates:
- Please include the exact hardware spec you’ll use for the sandbox (GPU model, memory, NVMe config).
- Can you confirm whether KV-cache warming is allowed pre-burst (we prefer realistic cold starts but may accept a short warm window).
- Procurement wants a commitment credit cap (we won’t agree to an open-ended credit).

If you can confirm those three items and provide the SOW, we’ll greenlight the Apr 16 start and loop Chris Becker from RivalAI to observe (transparency on both sides is fine).

Ari

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Kline <ari@windfall.io>, Procurement <procurement@windfall.io>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 16:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bake-off scope and benchmark instructions (attached)

Ari / team —

Appreciate the quick clarifying questions. Final confirmations:
- Hardware for sandbox: dual A100S (80GB) per node, local NVMe 3.2 TB, 512GB aggregate GPU memory per cluster (detailed spec in SOW).
- KV-cache: we’ll do a controlled warm window 5 minutes before each burst and record both warm and cold metrics — the acceptance criteria will use the end-of-window steady-state numbers.
- Commitment credit cap: 3 months of reserved fees max; if we miss SLA outside agreed tolerances we apply that cap.

Next steps: Ben will circulate the SOW + the commercial redwood_save_plan_v3.docx to Procurement by EOD Tue. Monica will schedule the bake-off calendar invite (Apr 16–29).

If Windfall signs the 6-month reserved commitment within 30 days of a successful bake-off, we’ll apply the 20% credit against the first 3 months and trigger the Vector Search pilot pricing.

Marissa
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

> Attachments: redwood_save_plan_v3.docx, benchmark_instructions_v1.pdf
